digest.component_or_area: ChatGPT agent guidance and Rebar tracker integration
propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack local Rebar checkout, direct Gerrit access, or tracker worktree but possess GitHub connector and repository visibility, requiring detection logic and safe fallback workflows not currently documented in AGENTS.md.

Native ticket creation is impossible precisely when both the tracker-worktree dimension fails (no accessible tickets branch checkout) AND the network/remote dimension fails or native rebar/rebar-mcp binary is unavailable; this decision rule must be stated explicitly to prevent incorrect fallback invocation.

Fallback ticket payloads must conform to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id as agent-generated UUID4, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and optional parent_id, producing the exact shape consumed by rebar import without hand-transcription.

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path; it accepts NDJSON, assigns fresh local ids/HLC timestamps, and is idempotent by source_id, while raw event-file injection or GitHub Contents-API writes to tickets branch are unsafe and must be prohibited.

In rebar import --dry-run mode, records missing ticket_id/ticket_type are silently skipped with no warning and no counter increment; malformed records are detectable only via would_create + skipped < total record count comparison.

Guidance must prohibit hand-authoring, modifying, or deleting event files, require search-before-create when tracker is accessible, state GitHub is a read-only mirror for code changes, and mandate rebar validate or rebar fsck after import to confirm store integrity.
